must_keep.quote: 2.26 Comparable Options: options will be comparable as long as the total cost for alternative fares are not higher than $2002 when compared to the LLF. Alternative options, routes, stops or connecting flights will be required if savings of $200 or more can be achieved without extending the total one- way air travel time by more than four (4) hours. The GS/OAS and the designated TMC will always use caution to ensure that savings will not compromise convenience, business purpose, or safety. Travelers will be allowed to use their judgment and complete travel even when the alternative options exceed this allowance. Those cases will be reported and may require additional justification.
